en.headline: Ceiling light panel falls in Yuen Long estate clubhouse playroom
en.dek: A resident of Uptown in Hung Shui Kiu said a section of suspended lights dropped in the clubhouse playroom on Saturday afternoon, with no injuries reported.
body: A section of ceiling panel fitted with hanging light rods fell to the floor in a clubhouse playroom at the Uptown private residential estate in Hung Shui Kiu, Yuen Long, on Saturday afternoon, the South China Morning Post reported.

A resident told the newspaper that the panel, which held a dense arrangement of vertically hanging light rods, came down suddenly in the Casa Club playroom at about 4pm. Citybase Property Management, which manages the estate and is a wholly owned subsidiary of CK Asset Holdings, was informed of the incident.

A security employee of the management company surnamed Chow told the newspaper that nobody had been injured. He said he needed more time to obtain further details of the incident and report them to his supervisor. The fall has raised safety concerns among some parents and residents at the estate.

zh.headline: 元朗Uptown會所遊戲室天花燈板墜落
zh.dek: 洪水橋Uptown住戶表示，周六下午會所遊戲室一段懸掛燈板突然跌下，暫無受傷報告。
body: 南華早報報道，周六下午元朗洪水橋私人屋苑Uptown的會所遊戲室內，一段裝有垂直懸掛燈桿的天花面板跌落地面。
一名住戶向報章表示，Casa Club會所遊戲室的該段天花板在下午約4時突然墜落。屋苑由Citybase物業管理負責管理，該公司為長江實業全資附屬公司。
管理公司一名姓周的保安人員向報章表示，事件中沒有人受傷。他說需要更多時間了解詳情，並向主管匯報。有家長及住戶對事件表示關注安全問題。
